subject: Blank page fix: start with one research question
preview: One sentence → outline. Skip the panic draft.
body: Hey {{first_name}} — a writing tip that actually helps:
Don't open a blank doc and “start writing.” Write one research question first (one sentence). That question is the filter for every paragraph that follows.
[[VALUE]]Research Generator does that path for you: question in, research statement + structured outline out — usually under 5 minutes.
[[SUB]]Free to try. No credit card to peek.
P.S. If the outline is weak, delete it. If it isn't, you just bought yourself a weekend.
